Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: sam123ben
Message:
feat(auth-bff): challenge unrecognised devices with an email OTP

A sign-in from a device the account has not used before now has to prove
control of the inbox before it gets a session, and the account holder is
mailed an alert naming the device, country and time either way.

Device history is evaluated before the session row is written — writing
it first would make the new device look familiar and suppress every
alert. A failed code send fails the login rather than falling through,
so disrupting the mail path cannot be used to walk past the gate, and
verification binds to the address in the pending cookie so a code minted
for one account cannot complete another's.

Codes are stored as HMAC-SHA256 under a server-side pepper; an empty
EMAIL_OTP_PEPPER or PLATFORM_API_URL leaves the gate off, since a
half-configured gate would block logins it cannot complete.

Adds migrations 0004 (user_email_otp) and 0005 (session fingerprint),
and a test pinning ExpectedSchemaVersion to the highest migration —
the constant had already drifted to 3 against 5 on disk, which would
have panicked the server at boot.

Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Samyak Rout
Message:
feat(payments): add Cashfree adapter as India's preferred gateway

Adds Cashfree Payment Gateway alongside Razorpay behind the existing
payment.Gateway abstraction, so refunds, webhooks, the refund saga and
admin gateway config all keep working through the generic paths. Ported
from the Home-Chef-App adapter to keep wire behaviour identical across
products.

Four places the abstraction had to bend, all additive and inert for
Stripe/Razorpay/PayPal:

- Cashfree refunds are order-scoped with no payment-level endpoint, so
  RefundInput gains OrderID. CreateIntent submits our order id as the
  Cashfree order_id, which keeps the refund target reconstructible from
  the ledger.
- Its SDK returns no signed receipt, so add the OrderStatusGateway
  capability plus POST /orders/:id/confirm-payment, which polls the
  gateway rather than verifying a client value. Provider, order id and
  expected amount are read server-side, never from the request body.
- Webhooks sign base64(HMAC(timestamp+body)), so both headers are packed
  into the single string VerifyWebhook takes, with a 30-minute skew bound.
- customer_phone is mandatory; threaded from the shipping address, which
  already enforces a valid 10-digit number for India.

Amounts cross the wire as rupee decimals rendered by integer arithmetic,
never through float64. Refund idempotency derives a deterministic sha256
digest truncated to Cashfree's refund_id window, and a duplicate 409/422
is read back as success so a retry cannot become a second real refund.

Migration 000098 puts cashfree at the head of India's payment_providers.
That array is now authoritative for preference: the payment-methods
endpoint had no ORDER BY, so picker order was previously whatever
Postgres returned. sortByPreference fixes that, and the storefront
pre-selects the first entry and badges it Recommended.

Also adds operational SQL to provision and diagnose a merchant's Cashfree
config, and discloses Cashfree as a sub-processor in the onboarding legal
pages.
